name: MyGene.info
summary: Gene annotation aggregated from many sources: symbols, names, Entrez/Ensembl ids, pathways, GO, variants and more, with query and batch lookup.
description: MyGene.info exposes a gene annotation service (/v3/gene/{id}) and a query service (/v3/query) over annotations merged from NCBI, Ensembl, UniProt, GO, pathways, orthology and other sources for many species. Responses are JSON, and the field list can be narrowed with fields=. Metadata at /v3/metadata reported build 20261030.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the pages fetched here; the docs mention request limits for batch calls (not re-confirmed).

license.name: Aggregated from many sources, each with its own terms (not re-confirmed)

coverage.geographic: Many species (human, mouse, rat, fly, worm, zebrafish and others)

agent_notes: Use fields=symbol,name,entrezgene to avoid the huge default gene document. Query with q=symbol:CDK2&species=human to disambiguate. Batch with POST /gene ids=1017,1018. Use _id (Entrez id) as the join key to other NCBI/Ensembl resources.
caveats: The default gene document is very large; always pass fields=.
License terms are those of the underlying sources; no single license was found.
Rate limit numbers were not confirmed.
